title: Tobias Beckett
subtitle: People are Predictable
text: Action [Exhaust]: Choose a friendly unit. An opponent takes control of it. If they do, create a Credit token.
deployBox: When Deployed: Defeat any number of units you own but don't control. For each unit defeated this way, create a Credit token and draw a card.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: If there are multiple opponents, the controlling player chooses which one will be “an opponent.”
